newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: EU finmins agree most stability pact details - Zalm.
newsitem.headline: EU finmins agree most stability pact details - Zalm.

text.p: Dutch Finance Minister Gerrit Zalm said on Saturday that European Union finance ministers had agreed most points of a stability pact text.

"We tried this morning to reach agreement on all the texts related to the growth and stability pact...and that has succeeded," Zalm told a news briefing at the meeting of the bloc's 15 ministers and central bank heads in the Dutch coastal resort of Noordwijk.

"There is one exception...and that relates to the fines levied... Political agreement has been reached on this (here)...that is a small legal point which will have to be examined by the monetary committee," he said.
The stability and growth pact, designed to enforce budgetary discipline once economic and monetary union (EMU) is launched, was agreed in principle by EU leaders in Dublin last December.
The pact seeks to penalise governments within monetary union which run annual deficits above three percent of GDP.
